scripts.prepare:local-assets: pnpm run prepare:jpeg-v2 && node scripts/copy-ocr-assets.mjs && pnpm run prepare:pdf
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir tmp/prerender --emptyOutDir && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src tests e2e tools/pdf-phase0/src tools/pdf-phase0/tests tools/pdf-phase0/vite.config.ts tools/pdf-phase0/playwright.config.ts scripts/pdf-preview.mjs scripts/pdf-preview-build-config.ts scripts/pdf-runtime-vite-plugin.ts scripts/worker-manifest-plugin.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts playwright.pdf-phase1c.config.ts playwright.pdf-release.config.ts playwright.pdf-improvements.config.ts scripts/generate-pdf-improvements.mjs tools/pdf-release
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:unit && node --test tests/route-bundles.test.mjs tests/guide-quality.test.mjs tests/sitemap.test.mjs tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/structured-data.test.mjs tests/funding.test.mjs tests/pdf-public-release.test.mjs tests/pdf-assets-pipeline.test.mjs tests/service-worker-pdf-cache.test.mjs tests/service-worker-ocr-cache.test.mjs tests/cloudflare-pdf-assets.test.mjs
scripts.test:rendered: pnpm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/structured-data.test.mjs tests/sitemap.test.mjs tests/guide-quality.test.mjs tests/funding.test.mjs
scripts.prepare:pdf-phase0: pnpm run prepare:ocr && pnpm run prepare:pdf && node tools/pdf-phase0/scripts/prepare.mjs
scripts.build:pdf-phase0: pnpm run typecheck:pdf-phase0 && pnpm run prepare:pdf-phase0 && vite build --config tools/pdf-phase0/vite.config.ts
scripts.preview:pdf-phase0: pnpm run build:pdf-phase0 && vite preview --config tools/pdf-phase0/vite.config.ts
scripts.test:pdf-phase0: pnpm run build:pdf-phase0 && playwright test --config tools/pdf-phase0/playwright.config.ts core.spec.ts privacy.spec.ts
scripts.test:pdf-phase1a: pnpm run build:pdf-phase0 && playwright test --config tools/pdf-phase0/playwright.config.ts decoder.spec.ts pdf-cache.spec.ts adapter.spec.ts
scripts.test:pdf-phase1b: pnpm run build:pdf-phase0 && playwright test --config tools/pdf-phase0/playwright.config.ts phase1b.spec.ts
scripts.test:pdf-phase1c:unit: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/components/pdf-ocr-page.test.tsx tests/unit/pdf-preview-build-config.test.ts tests/unit/pdf-state.test.ts tests/unit/pdf-extraction-runner.test.ts tests/unit/pdf-extraction-session.test.ts tests/unit/pdf-validation.test.ts tests/unit/service-worker-client.test.ts
scripts.test:pdf-phase1c: pnpm run prepare:pdf-phase0 && playwright test --config playwright.pdf-phase1c.config.ts
scripts.benchmark:pdf-phase0: pnpm run build:pdf-phase0 && playwright test --config tools/pdf-phase0/playwright.config.ts benchmark.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.benchmark:pdf-phase1b: pnpm run build:pdf-phase0 && playwright test --config tools/pdf-phase0/playwright.config.ts phase1b-benchmark.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:pdf-public-release: pnpm run prepare:pdf-phase0 && playwright test --config playwright.pdf-release.config.ts
scripts.test:pdf-improvements: pnpm run build && pnpm run prepare:pdf-phase0 && node scripts/generate-pdf-improvements.mjs && playwright test --config playwright.pdf-improvements.config.ts
